- `0ce9d9b`: seven-file stdio/HTTP lifecycle, entries/services and capability store.
- `784e3ad`: remote close replay, stdio events/backpressure and hello/ack framing.
- `6b21b98`: environment/platform detection, shell literals, Docker and WSL probes.
- `de3ff5c`: platform support gate and async-local progress ownership.
- `2de79f2`: deployment lock acquisition, deadlines and memoized cleanup.
- `57e5bfe`: remote asset decisions, live identity and install metadata ordering.
- `788b365`: runtime/agent wrappers; constrained matching source disclosed.

- `7204964`: backend factory/connect abort, RPC and stream lifecycle.

Each batch used a separate fresh internal author with no inherited conversation (Astra/high for batches 1–4; GPT-6.1 Sol/high for batches 5–39), supplied only a behavior contract and bounded API/behavior clarifications. The source-exposed observer reviewed compatibility, integrated complete authored files and formatted them. This is a provenance candidate with disclosed access limits, not an MIT decision or OS-enforced clean room. Root LICENSE, global provenance/inventory, dependencies, root remoteAssetCache/CDN/network helpers, unowned callers and authentication/permission settings remain unchanged. Later source-only authorization explicitly adds sshAuth, ssh-backend and agentOfficialPluginPermissionRepair to this PR; no real credentials/auth/permission operation is authorized or performed.

Historical batches1–10 used only focused checks, with no native/full-suite/build/semantic-type acceptance. Their contracts, exact baseline/draft/source hashes, immutable failures and access limits remain in the corresponding specs and licensing/evidence packets named by each commit above. This compact summary does not rewrite those records or reassert old checks as new executions. Node24.19.0 differs from pinned24.14.0.
